title: Q-AUDIT-dg-built-live: fm-built-without-evidence failing (fail): Run the tenant's graph step and set the row back to pending until its probe shows nodes.
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe dg-built-live
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-built-without-evidence` detected by `dg-built-live`, failing since 2026-11-25T21:07:45Z.
Evidence: x what-works: marked built, https://what-works.ultrastable.org/api/graph reports no nodes (the graph never ran)

Signature: d25f28dd36b5 (disposition: incident).
Suspected root cause: a knowledge-graph row is built but its probe answers no nodes
Remedy: Run the tenant's graph step and set the row back to pending until its probe shows nodes.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.
Three identical failures: this is an incident. Redesign the failing part; a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe dg-built-live

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T16:04:51Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 42.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
